page_title: UDI 0-2 GEN | Udinese v Genoa 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Enzo Ebosse (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90+2' Genoa are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Iker Bravo (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
87' Kosta Runjaic is forced to make a change. Keinan Davis is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Rui Modesto (Udinese).
87' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
86' Junior Messias (Genoa) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
84' It must be a yellow card. It is. Aaron Martin (Genoa) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
83' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle as Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
80' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is substituted due to injury. Patrick Vieira gives a chance to Alessandro Vogliacco.
80' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Mario Balotelli (Genoa) coming on for Alessandro Zanoli.
75' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Florian Thauvin and he is replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
69' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
69' It will be a substitution. Junior Messias (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Fabio Miretti walks off.
69' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replacing Milan Badelj.
67' 0 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:2.
66' Substitution. Sandi Lovric leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
66' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' The linesman signals that Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
60' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
58' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
57' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
54' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
52' A quickly taken corner by Genoa.

52' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper rises and gathers the ball. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
51' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) tackles a bit over-zealously and Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Genoa.
49' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
46' The game is over for Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese). Thomas Kristensen comes on for the second half.
46' Kosta Runjaic has made a change at the break. Enzo Ebosse has come on in place of Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Gianluca Aureliano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Milan Badelj (Genoa) was quite harsh and Gianluca Aureliano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
42' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Aureliano had an easy-decision to make.
42' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
42' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Aaron Martin (Genoa). Genoa have a corner.
36' The ball is laid off to Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Maduka Okoye to make a decent save.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
32' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Genoa have a corner.

31' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Nicola Leali was alert and the score remains the same.
29' The corner from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.
28' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

28' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
26' A pass lands at the feet of Morten Thorsby (Genoa) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
25' Maduka Okoye is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Fabio Miretti (Genoa). Easy save!
22' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle and it's Keinan Davis (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
19' The game is interrupted now, Fabio Miretti (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
17' The ball is cleared after Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Genoa as they win a corner.
15' Gianluca Aureliano sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
14' Wait! Referee Gianluca Aureliano has indicated he is going to review the Genoa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
12' Genoa are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
9' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game.
8' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) blasts the ball from the resulting free kick. His shot goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has an easy job.
5' Genoa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
4' Referee Gianluca Aureliano seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Isaak Toure (Udinese).

3' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Isaak Toure (Udinese) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
3' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' Isaak Toure (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Aureliano blows for a foul.
1' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano will supervise the game today.
